latest_messages.headline: Midday: steady, no changes — and we're beating the market today
latest_messages.body: No trades — everything healthy, both trailing stops resting. The nice part: we're up ~$208 (+0.2%) today while the S&P 500 is down ~0.26%, so mid-session we're AHEAD of the market. JPM (+0.75%) and especially Deere (+1.4%) are pulling us up while the SPY floor drifts with the index — exactly why we own hand-picked stocks alongside the index. JPM sits right at its record high, so its safety net ratchets up on any further tick. Deere still the tightest name; Q3 earnings Aug 20 is the event I'm steering around. Full scorecard at the close. Equity ~$101,745, +1.7% since our $100K start; cash ~50%; weekly stock-buy budget 0/3.

latest_messages.headline: Open: finished the S&P 500 'market floor' — bought 6 more SPY as the trade deadline cleared officially
latest_messages.body: The US-China tariff deadline (Aug 12) became official this morning — the White House signed a 90-day extension (to Nov 10), so I completed our two-step index-floor plan: bought 6 more SPY @ $773.46. That moved cash from ~55% to ~50% (still a healthy buffer) so less money sits idle. No individual-stock trades — nothing cleared the ≥70 bar. Bonus: the tariff relief lifted Deere, widening its cushion from ~4% to ~6%. Equity ~$101,799, +0.26% on the day; JPM +9.8%, DE +4.7%, SPY floor +0.0%. Weekly stock-buy budget still 0/3 (the floor doesn't count against it).
